paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得整理日常物品时注意被打断，却不想解释物品与经历的关系；另一次只记得休息时想法又回来。打断、当时需要和未知可以分别保留，不要求重建记忆或找出最强提醒。同一条类别容纳不同情境，既不数事件，也不判定某段经历的临床资格。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls interrupted attention while sorting ordinary belongings but wishes to keep their connection with an experience private. Another recollection contains only returning thoughts during rest. Interruption, present needs and unknowns stay separate without reconstructed memories or a search for the strongest reminder. A shared category can contain different settings without counting events or qualifying an experience clinically.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想谈日常活动被打断后的需要；不想讲原事件或解释某件物品；希望先了解谈话流程。”可以只读虚构卡。听者不追问细节，不测试记忆或故意拿来提醒材料；可以确认愿意怎样谈、何时停下，不承诺替代专业支持或要求先完成观察。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a need after an ordinary interruption, reserves the original event and the meaning of an object, and asks about the conversation process. Reading only the fictional card is enough. A listener seeks no details, tests no memory and introduces no reminder deliberately. They can ask how the person wishes to talk and when to stop, without promising to replace professional support or requiring completed observations.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是PCL-5、PTSD筛查、诊断、暴露或治疗练习。20条仍保留四组各五条的六类记录；计数算陈述，不算事件、症状或严重程度，未计分不补零。四个等长主题是编辑分组，不沿用PCL-5的5／2／7／6条症状分簇，不换算总分、阈值或临床资格。原观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值；四周是回忆框架，不是求助等待期。无需唤起或重述经历、接触提醒、证明环境安全或改变保护边界，任何组合不排除身体疾病或判断即时安全，不替代合适评估和既有照护。四篇全文与支持说明无需作答；复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含私人类别、事件、相关人员或健康资料。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not PCL-5, PTSD screening, diagnosis, exposure or treatment exercises. Twenty descriptions retain four six-category records of five. Counts concern statements, not events, symptoms or severity; unscored is not zero. Four equal-length topics are editorial groupings, not the PCL-5 symptom clusters of 5, 2, 7 and 6 items. They convert to no total, threshold or clinical qualification. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence; four weeks is a recall frame, not a waiting period for support. No recalled or retold event, reminder contact, proof of a safe setting or changed protective boundary is required. No pattern rules out a physical condition, assesses immediate safety or replaces appropriate assessment and existing care. All four guides and support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without private categories, events, people involved or health information.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得想参加一项活动，却不愿进入会被追问的谈话；另一件延后事务又涉及时间安排。参与意愿、隐私边界与实际条件可以分别保留，不把所有距离都解释为症状，也不从类别判断某地安全。例子不要求接受邀请、补做事务、联系相关人员或放弃保护自己的安排。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls wanting an activity while declining a conversation likely to invite unwanted questions. Another postponed task involves scheduling constraints. Interest, privacy boundaries and practical conditions remain separate without every distance becoming a symptom or a category determining a place is safe. The scene requires no accepted invitation, completed task, contact with people involved or abandoned protective arrangement.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡区分“仍想保留的边界”“现在想理解的困难”和“暂不讨论的内容”，可以全谈虚构例子。听者不以参加活动证明进步，不劝联系某人或接触提醒，也不把保留隐私当作不合作。可以只问哪种支持可谈，不制定面对提醒的任务，不代替已有专业计划。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a boundary to retain, a difficulty someone wants to understand and material outside the discussion, using only a fictional example if preferred. A listener requires no attendance as proof of progress, urges no contact or reminder exposure and treats no privacy as noncooperation. The exchange can ask what support is open to discussion without assigning confrontation tasks or replacing an existing professional plan.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得希望有人陪着处理普通事务，却不想接受对经历的解释；另一次活动变少，但不清楚是兴趣还是参与条件改变。陪伴、被提供的回应与活动机会可以分开描述，不由接收安慰的难易评价感恩、信任或联系能力。例子不要求主动社交、表现期待或把苛刻想法改成正面说法。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls wanting company for an ordinary task without accepting an explanation of the experience. Another recollection concerns less activity, with changed interest or access unclear. Company, the response offered and activity opportunity can be described separately without judging gratitude, trust or connection ability by how comfort is received. The scene requires no social contact, displayed anticipation or positive replacement for a harsh thought.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想要一种陪伴，但不想解释经历；哪些回应有用还不清楚；今天可以只谈实际需要。”可以只读。听者先问希望被听见还是需要协助，不用安慰被接受与否评判关系，也不让对方安抚帮助者；可以保留未知、暂停谈话，不因主题计数推断责任、价值或安全。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks for a form of company without an event explanation, leaves useful responses uncertain and allows discussion of a practical need alone. Reading is enough. A listener asks whether listening or practical help is wanted, judges no relationship by accepted comfort and requires no comforting of the helper. Unknowns and pauses remain possible, with no count-based inference of blame, worth or safety.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一次准备休息时仍留意周围，另一次普通任务因意外动静被打断，却不清楚两段是否有关。环境、睡眠机会、注意与未知可以分别保留，不由共同类别推断原因、危险已经解除或一般注意能力。例子不要求制造声响、扫描身体、检查周围、强迫放松或改变睡眠安排。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls watching the surroundings while preparing to rest and, on another occasion, an ordinary task interrupted by unexpected movement, without knowing whether the accounts are related. Setting, sleep opportunity, attention and unknowns remain separate without a shared category establishing cause, resolved danger or general attention ability. The scene requires no manufactured sound, body scan, surroundings check, forced relaxation or changed sleep arrangement.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得当时紧绷或被打断；原因和更多细节想先保留；想问怎样谈日常影响。”可以只读虚构卡。听者不突然触碰、制造刺激或让人证明能够平静，不把烦躁等同伤害意图，也不以记录少保证环境或身体安全；需要哪种支持仍由更完整的实际情境决定。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names remembered tension or interruption, reserves causes and further detail and asks how to discuss daily effects. Read only the fictional card. A listener uses no surprise touch, manufactured stimulus or proof of calm, equates no irritability with harmful intent and offers no environmental or physical safety guarantee from a sparse record. Appropriate support still depends on fuller real circumstances.
